news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.40 (vs ₹2.30 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.40 (up from ₹2.30 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹149.2m (up 22% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.47m (up ₹9.95m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.0% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 119 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
